Topic.label: Determining Whether a Line Is Perpendicular to a Plane

Question:
What is the relationship between a lateral edge of a rectangular prism and its base?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h120_q4_question_en.svg)

Choices.D: The edge lies in the base

Solution: The lateral edge is perpendicular to two intersecting edges of the base, so it is perpendicular to the base.
